experiment_seeds.role: Governs repository-side stochasticity: dataset subsampling, paired bootstrap resamples, adversarial perturbation generation, and branch construction.

provider_sampling_seeds.role: Provider-specific API parameter where supported. Distinct from repository experiment seed.
provider_sampling_seeds.determinism_caveat: API seed parameters provide best-effort reproducibility on backend infrastructure but do NOT guarantee bitwise determinism across GPU cluster reconfigurations.

sv_decomposition.description: Selectivity harm avoided (S) plus verification harm avoided (V) exactly equals total harm reduction (Delta).
